environment.description: Celery worker deployed on RHEL 9 bare-metal host with custom SELinux type enforcement policy (celery_worker_t). Policy compiled from refpolicy module with only the following type transitions and access vectors granted: allow celery_worker_t celery_data_t:file { read write create unlink }; allow celery_worker_t celery_data_t:dir { search add_name remove_name }; allow celery_worker_t redis_port_t:tcp_socket { name_connect }; allow celery_worker_t self:process { signal }; allow celery_worker_t proc_t:file { read }; All other access vectors denied with dontaudit suppression disabled (auditallow for debugging). Process runs in enforcing mode with MLS sensitivity s0. File contexts: /var/lib/worker(/.*)? system_u:object_r:celery_data_t:s0. No unconfined_t domain transition permitted. Boolean deny_execmem=on, secure_mode_policyload=on.

config.exec_transition: no transition to unconfined_t or shell_exec_t allowed
config.audit_mode: auditallow on celery_worker_t for all denied operations
